The observed relationship implies that Dihydropinosylvin could influence the function of Peptide deformylase, which in turn affects the cellular response of HEK-293T cells. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role for Dihydropinosylvin in cellular regulation, potentially through interactions with metabolic enzymes that are critical for cell function.
